newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.044pts to 101.283.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.044pts to 101.283.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds lost 0.044 points in Thursday's trading to 101.283, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.514 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell 0.077 points to 97.695, the bank said, while the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.289 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 2.642 points to 1,121.766.
